correctness.rationale: The cubic defining relations force D(x),D(y) into the 5-dimensional maximal ideal in every characteristic, and every pair of images there is allowed. The five-by-five matrix has blocks A,B,T_A, and its rank is rank(A)+rank(T_A)+rank of the induced ker(A)→coker(T_A) map. Surjectivity of the restriction map from arbitrary B gives exactly q^(6-(2-s)(3-t)) times the rectangular-matrix-rank count. The complete four-type stratification of A is verified by det(T_A)=4tr(A)det(A) in odd characteristic and T_A being one-column in characteristic two. Inserting rank counts yields every coefficient and normalization H_q(1)=q^10. The delivered verify.py independently performs full derivation enumeration over F_2 and F_3 and field-aware A-stratum checks over orders 2,3,4,5. Finite experiments are supporting tests, not the proof.
